errors.text_span: етикетирана с надпис „Деца в риск от бедност и социално изключване“
errors.evidence: The text "Деца в риск от бедност и социално изключване" is the title of the chart, not the label for the vertical axis, which is unlabeled.

errors.text_span: най-високите стълби са за Сърбия (най-високата стойност, приблизително 49%) и Турция (приблизително 48%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies Serbia as having the highest value. The chart shows that Turkey (Турция) has the highest bar (approx. 48%), while Serbia (Сърбия) is lower (approx. 44%).

The description incorrectly identifies Slovakia (Словакия) as one of the countries with the lowest values at approximately 13%. The bar for Slovakia is actually at approximately 23%. The country with a value around 12-13% is Slovenia (Словения), not Slovakia.
The value for Serbia (Сърбия) is approximately 44%, not 49% as stated in the description.

The description states that the y-axis represents a percentage ("процентната част"), but there is no '%' symbol or unit label on the axis to confirm this. This is an assumption, not an objective observation from the figure.
